q: I can’t sign in. What should I do?
tags: login log in logging in account access locked cannot can't sign in
answer:
Open My Timber sign-in and use the email address you registered with. If you’ve forgotten your password, choose ‘Forgotten your password?’.

If you’re asked to verify your email, request a fresh verification email from the sign-in screen. Use the newest link you receive.

Still stuck? Tell website support which page you were using and the error message you saw. Keep your existing account so your progress stays together.
label: Open My Timber sign-in

q: How do I reset my password?
tags: forgot forgotten lost password reset change
answer:
1. Open My Timber sign-in and choose ‘Forgotten your password?’.
  2. Enter your account email address and choose ‘Send reset link’.
  3. Check your inbox and junk folder. Open the newest reset link and choose a new password.
  4. Return to sign in with your new password.

Keep reset links private. If a link won’t work, request a new one.
label: Reset my password

q: My verification email is missing or the link has expired.
tags: no email missing email didn't arrive verification verify expired junk spam register registration
answer:
Check the inbox and junk folder for the email address you used to register.

Go to My Timber sign-in and enter that same address. If it still needs verification, choose ‘Send a fresh verification email’. An expired or already-used link also offers that recovery option.

Use the newest link, then return to sign in. If it still doesn’t arrive, contact website support. Never share your verification link or create another account to recover your progress.
label: Get a fresh verification link

q: Where do I go for an order or payment question?
tags: order payment charged refund delivery dispatch tracker receipt billing
answer:
Open My Timber for your account and order information. For a payment query, contact SHIFT, choose ‘My order’ and include the payment date and reference if you have them.

For refund information, read the refunds policy. Don’t send card details, bank details or unnecessary medical documents.
label: Open My Timber

q: Who should I ask about my medicine or dose?
tags: medicine medication prescription dose jab injection side effect prescriber pharmacist clinical
answer:
Contact your treating prescriber or dispensing pharmacist for advice about your own medicine, dose or symptoms. Ask Timber can explain general information; it cannot choose a medicine or dose, confirm suitability or replace a clinician.

If you need urgent help, use the health-help routes below rather than waiting for a company inbox.
label: Explore treatment information

q: Can I use My Timber if my treatment comes from elsewhere?
tags: another provider elsewhere existing clinic free membership buying buy purchase
answer:
Yes. Free My Timber gives you food ideas, movement options, goals and check-ins without a treatment purchase or a change of provider.

Your current prescriber remains the contact for medicine decisions and clinical care.
label: Explore free My Timber

q: Where should I start with SHIFT?
tags: getting started start here what is shift help navigate programme free first week
answer:
If you’re not sure which route fits, Start Here helps you explore where to begin. The Programme explains how SHIFT’s practical support fits together.

My Timber brings your food, movement, goals and check-ins into one place. Its practical support is free to use.
label: Find my starting point

q: A page, tool or button isn’t working. How do I report it?
tags: broken bug not working button page error technical website tool safari chrome mobile
answer:
Tell website support the page you were on, what you expected and what happened instead. Include the error wording and the approximate time, plus your device and browser if you know them.

A screenshot can help, but remove passwords, private links, payment details and health information that isn’t needed.
label: Report a website problem

q: How do I manage my information or close my account?
tags: data export download information erase erasure delete close account privacy settings records
answer:
Open My Timber settings for the available data, health-history and account controls. The Privacy Policy explains how SHIFT uses information and how to contact us about your data rights.

If you need help finding a control or making a request, contact the SHIFT team. Don’t include more personal information than the request needs.
label: Open My Timber

q: Where can I change my cookie choices?
tags: cookies consent tracking preferences choices settings analytics
answer:
Use ‘Cookie choices’ at the bottom of the page to reopen your preferences. The Cookie Policy explains the cookies used by SHIFT.

If the control isn’t working, contact website support and tell us your device and browser.
label: Read the Cookie Policy
